health-topic.title: Chest Pain
health-topic.full-summary:
SYNTHETIC TEST TEXT. Chest pain has many possible causes. Some are mild, such as muscle strain or heartburn, and some are serious.

Features that can accompany chest pain include

  • Pain spreading to the arm or jaw
  • Sweating

health-topic.title: Heart Attack
health-topic.full-summary:
SYNTHETIC TEST TEXT. A heart attack happens when blood flow to the heart is blocked.

Call 911 if you think someone may be having a heart attack.

full-summary.p: SYNTHETIC TEST TEXT. Abdominal pain is felt anywhere between the chest and the groin. Causes range from gas to infections.
See your health care provider if the pain is severe or does not go away.

health-topic.title: Headache
health-topic.full-summary: SYNTHETIC TEST TEXT. A headache is pain in the head or face. Many headaches are tension headaches.

health-topic.title: Dehydration
health-topic.full-summary: SYNTHETIC TEST TEXT. Dehydration means your body does not have enough fluid. Fluids and rest are the usual approach.

health-topic.title: Knee Pain
health-topic.full-summary: SYNTHETIC TEST TEXT. Pain, pain, and more pain in the knee. Knee pain can follow a pain-causing injury.
